chunks.note: 東西漏水時這樣報修。is leaking 表示現在正在漏。

distractors.text: My kitchen sink is leak.
My kitchen sink leaking.
My kitchen sink is leacking.

chunks.en: There's water all over the floor.
accept: There is water all over the floor.
chunks.note: There's = There is。all over the floor 是「整個地上都是」。

distractors.text: There's water all over floor.
There's water all the over floor.
There's waters all over the floor.

chunks.en: Can someone come and fix it today?
accept: Can someone come fix it today?
Can somebody come and fix it today?
chunks.note: 請人來修東西。come and fix 兩個動詞都用原形。

distractors.text: Can someone come and fixes it today?
Can someone come and fix today?
Can someone come fix and it today?

chunks.note: 約時間時說自己哪時在家。all afternoon 前面不加 in。

distractors.text: I'm home in all afternoon.
I home all afternoon.
I'm home all afternoons.

chunks.en: Should I take all these things out?
chunks.zh: 要我先把這些東西都拿出來嗎？
accept: Should I take all of these things out?
chunks.note: 問對方「我該不該…」：Should I + 動詞原形…?

distractors.text: Should I to take all these things out?
Should I take all these thing out?
I should take all these things out?

chunks.note: 修好後試一下，說「看起來沒問題了」。

distractors.text: It seem okay now.
It's seems okay now.
It seems okey now.

chunks.en: I just bought this used car.
chunks.note: bought 是 buy 的過去式；used car = 二手車。

distractors.text: I just buyed this used car.
I just bought this use car.
I just bought used this car.

chunks.en: It makes a strange noise when I drive.
chunks.zh: 我開車的時候它會發出怪聲。
chunks.note: 說車子的毛病：It makes a … noise。

distractors.text: It makes strange noise when I drive.
It make a strange noise when I drive.
It makes a noise strange when I drive.

chunks.en: So I don't need a whole new engine?
chunks.zh: 所以我不用換一整顆新引擎？
chunks.note: So 開頭，確認剛聽到的事：「所以…？」

distractors.text: So I don't need a new whole engine?
So I doesn't need a whole new engine?
So I don't need whole new engine?

chunks.en: Do I really need new tires?
chunks.note: 覺得不一定要換時問。really 放在 need 前面。

distractors.text: Do I really need new tire?
Do I really needs new tires?
I do really need new tires?

chunks.en: That's a bit too expensive for me.
chunks.zh: 這對我來說有點太貴了。
accept: That is a bit too expensive for me.
chunks.note: too + 形容詞 = 太…（超過能接受的）。a bit 讓語氣客氣一點。

distractors.text: That's a bit to expensive for me.
That's bit too expensive for me.
That's a bit expensive too for me.

chunks.en: Let's just fix the brakes for now.
accept: Let us just fix the brakes for now.
chunks.note: Let's + 動詞原形；for now = 目前先這樣。

distractors.text: Let's just fixing the brakes for now.
Let's just fix brakes for now.
Let's just fix the brakes now for.

chunks.en: Hi, I'm here for my car.
accept: Hi, I am here for my car.
Hello, I'm here for my car.
chunks.note: 到店裡取車、取東西時說：I’m here for + 東西。

distractors.text: Hi, I'm here for me car.
Hi, I here for my car.
Hi, I'm for here my car.

chunks.zh: 現在聲音聽起來很正常了。
chunks.note: sound 當動詞是「聽起來」，後面接 good，不接 well。

distractors.text: It sounds really well now.
It sound really good now.
It's sounds really good now.

words.zh: 房子（Mr. Bell 自己的家）

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, this is Mr. Bell. What's up?
scene.zh: 喂，我是 Bell。怎麼了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: My kitchen sink is leaking.
scene.zh: 我廚房的水槽在漏水。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's not good. Is it a big leak?
scene.zh: 不妙。漏得很嚴重嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: There's water all over the floor.
scene.zh: 地上都是水。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry. That happens in these old apartments.
scene.zh: 抱歉。這種老公寓常會這樣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay. Turn off the water under the sink for now.
scene.zh: 好。先把水槽下面的水關掉。

fills.en: Can someone come and ___ it today?
fills.note: come and 後面的動詞也用原形。

fills.en: The water is coming out of the ___.
fills.note: 水會從牆壁流出來，工具和師傅不會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi, it's Mr. Bell. The plumber's busy until Friday.
scene.zh: 嗨，我是 Bell。水電師傅要到星期五才有空。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Can someone come and fix it today?
scene.zh: 今天可以找人來修嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can do it. I have tools at my house.
scene.zh: 我自己來修吧。我家裡有工具。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: When's a good time for you?
scene.zh: 你什麼時候方便？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm home all afternoon.
scene.zh: 我整個下午都在家。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. Don't worry, I can fix it quickly.
scene.zh: 好。別擔心，我很快就能修好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let's see. It's really dark in this cabinet.
scene.zh: 我看看。這個櫃子裡面好暗。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I take all these things out?
scene.zh: 要我先把這些東西都拿出來嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, please. Pull them out slowly so nothing falls.
scene.zh: 好，麻煩你。慢慢拉出來，東西才不會掉。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, I dropped my tool. Can you get it?
scene.zh: 抱歉，我的工具掉了。你可以幫我撿嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There, all done. Try the water now.
scene.zh: 好，修好了。你開水試試看。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It seems okay now.
scene.zh: 現在看起來好了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. You can push your things back in.
scene.zh: 很好。你可以把東西推回去了。

tasks.title: 把剛買的二手車開去修車廠

passages.title: Car shop (Tony)
lines: Hi, this is Tony at the shop. I checked your car.
The engine is OK. The trouble is in the back.
Estimate: back of the car $280, oil change $60. Total $340.

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Welcome to the shop! I'm Tony, the mechanic.
scene.zh: 歡迎光臨！我是修車師傅 Tony。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I just bought this used car.
scene.zh: 我剛買了這台二手車。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right, Mr. Bell told me. For job interviews.
scene.zh: 對，Bell 先生跟我說過了。要開去面試嘛。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, what's the trouble?
scene.zh: 那車子有什麼問題？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It makes a strange noise when I drive.
scene.zh: 我開車的時候它會發出怪聲。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That sound could be the engine.
scene.zh: 那個聲音可能是引擎。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me look. I can send you an estimate later.
scene.zh: 我看一下，晚一點傳估價給你。

lines.en: Hi, my car lights don't work.
Let me check. Yes, I can fix them today.
lines.zh: 我看看。嗯，今天就能修好。

lines.en: Great! When can I pick it up?
lines.zh: 太好了！我什麼時候可以來拿車？

lines.en: At four this afternoon. It's sixty dollars.

questions.en: When can she pick up her car?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! Did you get my message?
scene.zh: 嗨！有收到我的訊息嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I checked the engine, and it looks okay.
scene.zh: 我檢查過引擎了，看起來沒問題。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So I don't need a whole new engine?
scene.zh: 所以我不用換一整顆新引擎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No. It's your brakes. There's some damage.
scene.zh: 不用。是煞車，有點損壞。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can repair them. I'd also replace your tires.
scene.zh: 煞車我可以修。還有，輪胎我建議換掉。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I really need new tires?
scene.zh: 輪胎真的要換新的嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Probably. They're really old.
scene.zh: 大概要喔，它們已經很舊了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: With four new tires, it's $740.
scene.zh: 加上四個新輪胎，總共七百四十塊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: That's a bit too expensive for me.
scene.zh: 這對我來說有點太貴了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I understand. But bad brakes are dangerous.
scene.zh: 我懂。可是煞車壞了很危險。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I see accidents all the time.
scene.zh: 我常常看到車禍。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let's just fix the brakes for now.
scene.zh: 那先修煞車就好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good call. Safety first.
scene.zh: 好決定，安全第一。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Your tires are good enough for a few months.
scene.zh: 你的輪胎再撐幾個月沒問題。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can finish it by tomorrow.
scene.zh: 我明天就可以修好。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Hi, I'm here for my car.
scene.zh: 你好，我來牽車。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi! It's almost done. I'm just finishing the inspection.
scene.zh: 嗨！快好了，我在做最後的檢查。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Okay, all good. Take it for a short drive.
scene.zh: 好，都沒問題。你開一小段試試看。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It sounds really good now.
scene.zh: 現在聲音聽起來很正常了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. And the new brakes have a warranty for one year.
scene.zh: 對啊。新的煞車有一年保固。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: By the way, you're almost out of gas. Fill it up today.
scene.zh: 對了，你快沒油了，今天記得去加滿。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hi there! What can I do for you?
scene.zh: 嗨！需要什麼嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Hi, I'm here for my car.
scene.zh: 你好，我來牽車。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sure! Sorry, the shop's full today. Ten more minutes?
scene.zh: 好！抱歉，今天店裡很滿。再等十分鐘好嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem, we can wait. So, how is the apartment?
scene.zh: 沒關係，我們可以等。對了，公寓住得還好嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: My kitchen sink is leaking.
scene.zh: 我廚房的水槽在漏水。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Again? Sorry. I think we need to replace it.
scene.zh: 又漏了？抱歉。我看要整個換掉了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Can I come by today?
scene.zh: 我今天過去可以嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm home all afternoon.
scene.zh: 我整個下午都在家。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good, see you at three. Wait, is that your car?
scene.zh: 好，三點見。咦，那是你的車嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I just bought this used car.
scene.zh: 我剛買了這台二手車。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Here are your keys. Try the brakes.
scene.zh: 鑰匙給你。試一下煞車。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It seems okay now.
scene.zh: 現在看起來好了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And the noise?
scene.zh: 那怪聲呢？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: It sounds really good now.
scene.zh: 現在聲音聽起來很正常了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Great. But your tires are really old.
scene.zh: 很好。不過你的輪胎真的很舊了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do I really need new tires?
scene.zh: 輪胎真的要換新的嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: In a month or two. Today, I can do them for $400.
scene.zh: 一兩個月內要換。今天換的話四百塊。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: That's a bit too expensive for me.
scene.zh: 這對我來說有點太貴了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem. Come back next month.
scene.zh: 沒關係，下個月再來。
